grammar.summary: 本课学习 at times 与 repeatedly 表频率的副词。

points.title: 频率副词的位置
points.explanation: at times = 有时，可放句首；repeatedly = 再三地，放实义动词前。频率信息的位置有讲究。

examples.en: At times, the sea is very rough.

points.title: 表"声称"的 claim to do
points.explanation: Fishermen claim to have seen monsters. claim + to have done 表"声称曾做过"（完成不定式）。

examples.en: They claim to have seen a monster.
